message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of them have positive reviews and a reputation for fresh, flavorful dishes. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------| | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑1234 | [siamthai.com](https://www.siamthai.com) | • **Vegetarian Pad Thai** (no egg, tofu or shrimp)
• **Vegetarian Green Curry** (tofu, mixed veggies, coconut milk)
• **Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup** (vegetable broth, mushrooms, lemongrass) | | **Thai Orchid** | 2001 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (773) 555‑5678 | [thaiochard.com](https://www.thaiochard.com) | • **Vegetarian Massaman Curry** (potato, carrot, chickpeas)
• **Vegetarian Pad Krapow** (tofu, basil, chili)
• **Vegetarian Spring Rolls** (fresh veggies, rice paper) | | **Bangkok Bistro** | 400 W 19th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑9876 | [bangkokbistro.com](https://www.bangkokbistro.com) | • **Vegetarian Red Curry** (tofu, bell pepper, bamboo shoots)
• **Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Tofu & Broccoli** (soy sauce, garlic)
• **Vegetarian Mango Sticky Rice** (dessert) | | **Lanna Thai Kitchen** | 1500 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑2468 | [lannathai.com](https://www.lannathai.com) | • **Vegetarian Panang Curry** (tofu, sweet potato, coconut milk)
• **Vegetarian Pad See Ew** (tofu, broccoli, soy sauce)
• **Vegetarian Papaya Salad** (green papaya, lime, peanuts) | | **Taste of Thailand** | 3000 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (773) 555‑3456 | [tasteofthailand.com](https://www.tasteofthailand.com) | • **Vegetarian Tom Kha Soup** (coconut milk, mushrooms, galangal)
• **Vegetarian Pad Kee Mao** (tofu, basil, chili)
• **Vegetarian Fried Rice** (tofu, peas, carrots) | ### How to choose - **Check the menu online** – most of these restaurants post their full menus on their websites, so you can see all vegetarian options before you go. - **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan”** – the staff usually knows which dishes can be made vegetarian or vegan. If you’re unsure, just say you’re looking for vegetarian options and they’ll guide you. - **Look for “tofu” or “vegetable”** – many Thai dishes can be easily swapped for tofu or extra vegetables. - **Try the curries** – Thai curries are naturally vegetarian-friendly when you skip the meat. - **Desserts** – sticky rice with mango or coconut ice cream are great vegetarian desserts. Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
